name: Roshutsu Play Shoujo 3 ~Mou Mitsukatte mo Yoi... Motto Motto Kageki na Koto ga Shitai★Hen
original_name: 露出プレイ少女3～もう見つかっても良い…もっともっと過激な事がしたい★篇
source:
Meet Rina Hoshino, a girl with the power of Psychometry. She has the ability to read the memories of people and locations. In this novel game you can take her from place to place and "peep" on the exposed lewd girls. As a result of your choices, you can discover new thrills, or get a bad ending, etc.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ110440.html]DLsite English[/url]]
